name: Minecraft Paintings
summary: Minecraft Paintings is a small-scale aesthetic content mod that adds all 30 paintings featured in Minecraft, manually recreated to include less noise and tile dimensions fitting Terraria paintings.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 添加《我的世界》的 30 幅画作，手工重绘以减少杂点，并适配泰拉瑞亚的画作尺寸。
